author: Kusha N M
raw:
ನಿನ್ನ ನಂಬಿಕೆಗಳನು ಅನ್ಯರಿಗೆ ಹೇರದಿರು
ತನ್ನತನ ಮೆರೆವುದಕೆ ದಾರಿಯನು ನೀಡು
ಮನ್ನಿಸುತ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳ ಅವಕಾಶವೀಯುತಿರೆ
ಮುನ್ನಡೆದು ನೆನೆಯುವರು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Don’t force your beliefs on others;
give them room to show who they are;
if you forgive mistakes and keep giving chances,
they will move ahead and remember you, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Let others hold their own views and find their own way. Forgiving mistakes and giving people a chance is what they remember with gratitude.
